description: Two hard clippers with a display, each holding a polyphonic signal within a set voltage; leave the outputs unpatched and it works as a clip and logic monitor

params.text: Sets the clipping voltage for both signals and every channel, 0-10V, starting at 5V; it does nothing while the Vclip input is patched

inputs.text: Sets the clipping voltage directly, one channel per clipping voltage over 0-20V, and takes over from the Vclip knob; a negative voltage counts as its positive value
The first signal to be clipped, polyphonic; its channels show on the display in blue, turning red while a channel is clipping
The second signal to be clipped, polyphonic

outputs.text: The first signal after clipping, held within plus or minus the clipping voltage
The second signal after clipping, held within plus or minus the clipping voltage

menu: Logic Monitoring — treats low-to-high and high-to-low changes alike on the display, which suits watching 0-10V logic with the clipping voltage at 5V; it does not work with bipolar signals
